notes.title: Achievements fixed!
notes.notes:
Hi, you all, it's been a while!

We're here with a brand-new patch that addresses some issues with achievements and other bugs. Sorry it took us this much, but we've been busy working on ports and an online patch that should solve the connection issues.

[h2][b]Here are the fixes:[/b][/h2]

FIXED: Beary well and Bear minimum achievements were unable to obtain
FIXED: You'll need to beat the game again to unlock the nuclear skins. Now, if you've already beaten the game, you should have the skins unlocked
FIXED: More small issues

We'll keep working on fixing the connection issues, and if you find any new bugs or issues, please let us know!

Thanks for the patience!

notes.title: Our new game has a demo now!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

[b]Gnaughty Gnomes[/b] is our new game! You can already[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3454480/Gnaughty_Gnomes/] [b]try its demo for free[/b][/url].

[h3]👊 Become a fighting gnome![/h3]

Gnaughty Gnomes is a very crazy and frantic party game in which you:

🔹 Use any object on the stage as a weapon (ANYTHING you can imagine!)
🔹 Choose cards with the most craziness skills of different rarities 
🔹 Fight on themed maps (5 of each type)
🔹 Customize your gnome 
🔹 Taunt your enemies with gestures

[previewyoutube=D4AJXis_yO4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]🎮 What's included in the demo?[/h3]

In this first playable version you can enjoy:

🔹 10 different maps of aquarium and airport (the final version will have +20)
🔹 45 upgrade cards with different synergies (the game will have +120)
🔹 15 customization options per body part
🔹 3 win games, with upgrade selection between each round

[h3]🛠️ We want your feedback[/h3]

This demo is very important to us. We would love to know what you think about the game. If you feel like it, leave us your comments, ideas, funny clips or bugs you find [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2F5z2bnKQw]on our Discord[/url].

[h3]☺️ Thanks for your support[/h3]

If you enjoy the demo, don't forget to add [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3454480/Gnaughty_Gnomes/]Gnaughty Gnomes to your wishlist[/url]. You will help us a lot and you will be up to date with all the news.

Remember that you can also follow us on [b][url=https://linktr.ee/SandCastlesStudio]our social networks[/url][/b].

See you soon!

notes.title: Halloween is coming to Bread & Fred! 🎃
notes.notes:
This is the first time you will be able to enjoy [b]Halloween in Bread & Fred[/b]! During the whole month of October, there will be an update for the game.

You will find a new event inside the [b]main penguins' house[/b]. Remember that the house is located down and to the left of the first map. It is the igloo of Bread and Fred. 

Once there, you will see that strange things are happening [b]in the bed[/b], so if you interact with it, you will activate the Halloween event. 👻

[previewyoutube=zMk5jbaSyX4;full][/previewyoutube]

You will arrive at a [b]terrifying mansion[/b] where some of the game's most popular characters are waiting for you. Here, [b]Greg[/b] will ask you to r[b]esolve a mistery[/b] like good penguin detectives!

In addition, the penguins of New Beakville have decorated the town and Zone 1 of the game with [b]cute pumpkins [/b]to celebrate Halloween. 🎃

We hope you enjoy this little event. We are still working on more game content to thank you for all the support you have given us during all this time.

notes.title: NEW LANGUAGES FOR BREAD & FRED
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

While we are working on some big special things you all are waiting for (and some other secret stuff), we decided to incorporate some new languages to the range we already have in Bread & Fred! We think it is important that everyone can enjoy the game in their own language, so all of us at Sand Castles want to embrace and recognise the identity a language has for their users.

So, we are adding: Polish, Turkish and Latin American Spanish!

In total we have 13 languages including: English, European Spanish, Catalan, French, Italian, German, Portuguese (Brazil), Chinese (Simplified), Japanese, Korean and NOW Polish, Turkish, Spanish (LATAM)

For now we are putting a pause on more localization, but what other languages are you guys missing?

notes.title: Online Multiplayer Fix
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377537/dc49260195d6471ae97c0756d1533c98e4d01970.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

We know some of you have been experiencing some issues regarding the online multiplayer. It's been quite difficult to know what was the problem, since some players experienced connections issues, others have an extreme ping and in general it wasn't a consistent problem to solve immediately, so we need to solve this ASAP.

We are working on a mini-rework on the online system that probably will solve a lot of these issues (we hope so at least) and we hope to launch this fix very soon, we just need a little bit of patience. We know Bread & Fred relies heavily on the multiplayer aspect, and we hate that some of you aren't having a good experience with it. Don't worry, we are aware of these problems, and we are doing everything in our hands. If you want this fix to be sooner, you can help us out explaining exactly what connection/lag issues you have and not only "online works bad", that way we can attack the specific problem and not take a shot in the dark, as most people play the game just fine.


Thank you everyone for your patience, I know you love the game as much as we do, so stay tuned for the online patch soon.

notes.title: Remote Play Assistance
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Until the peer-2-peer online multiplayer mode releases [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1607680/allnews/]in our summer update[/url], the current method to play online is via Steam's Remote Play function. 

Here are some notes that will fix some common problems we see and get you climbing the mountain with your friend!

1. After starting the game with Remote Play, press Shift+Tab to open the Steam interface. There you'll be able to see a list of your friends to invite. 

2. To avoid running into issues where one play cannot use the keyboard to play, make sure you allow them access by clicking the right option by their name. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377537/e60dea129827024c66413d9e928337cc93c81338.jpg[/img]

When using Remote Play, there can be a delay or a performance loss depending on the distance between you and your chosen partner. Closer distances will perform better. 

Thanks everyone for your support so far. Have fun!

notes.title: Regarding Online Multiplayer
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40377537/a1ecec54f8787548dfb85038ebe8ad62b2f8a5b1.png[/img]

One of the most requested features for Bread & Fred has been online multiplayer. We've heard all of your requests and we can say that we've been working on Online for quite a while now. 

We've been working really hard to create the best experience for the game, but we're not quite there yet.

[h2]So, quick answers:[/h2]
[h3]WILL BREAD & FRED HAVE ONLINE?[/h3] [b]Yes[/b]
[h3]WILL ONLINE BE AVAILABLE ON LAUNCH? [/h3][b]No[/b]

Peer-2-Peer multiplayer mode will not quite be ready upon the game's release on May 23rd. We hope to have it ready by the next content update (which should be out [b]during the month of June![/b]). In the meantime, Steam itself provides a "Remote Play Together" mode that works pretty well in most cases, assuming the two players are not more than a few hundred miles apart. And of course, the game supports two-player mode from the same PC.

[h2]Why is it taking so long?[/h2]

We're a small team of developers and online multiplayer is always a challenge! But for Bread & Fred it's an even bigger monster. While on most games you can allow for some lag within the players, in Bread & Fred, each action of one player directly affects the other (changing his position, velocity, rotation...) that makes creating a smooth experience much harder as a bit of lag from one end can cause a massive changes in game physics for both players.

We don't feel comfortable with the current state of P2P multiplayer and we don't want to deliver a laggy and unfinished experience. That's why we've come to a decision of delaying it a bit and having this extra month to really polish it and ship the online multiplayer experience that the game deserves. 

We hope to have P2P working soon! Thanks for understanding!

[h1]So, no online... YET[/h1]
